shops.name: Ollivanders wand shop
shops.palette: walnut, aged plum plaster, amber and antique brass
shops.prompt:
Use case: game concept art and production design sheet. Landscape 3:2 concept sheet for a finished shop in Wildbound's Diagon Alley. Rich 32-bit-era 2D pixel art, late-1990s hand-painted RPG pixel environments: organically worn silhouettes, convincing perspective, rounded shaded material masses, warm directional light, crisp coherent pixel clusters. Grounded in a living forest game's lush, shaded pixel-art quality. NOT a low-poly 3D render, NOT flat geometric boxes, NOT modern vector art, NOT an 8-bit NES palette, no plastic shine or noise grain. One main beautifully composed cutaway exterior/interior scene occupies two thirds of the sheet, remaining third is a tidy callout catalogue of exactly 20 distinct production assets used in that scene. Eye-level slightly elevated three-quarter view that makes floor placement and open walkways legible. Readable focal hierarchy, broad shade ramps, restrained details. Keep gameplay door and counter approach open. Include one tiny cloaked pixel student for scale. No HUD, no watermark, no copyrighted film still, no photo textures. Each asset is a different designed object, never twenty recolors of a crate. Shop title may be present; asset labels optional and short.
Subject: Ollivanders wand shop. Palette/material direction: walnut, aged plum plaster, amber and antique brass.
Exactly twenty designed assets: crooked gable; amber bay window; narrow carved door; hanging wand sign; floor-to-ceiling wand-box cabinet; rolling ladder; sorting counter; open velvet wand case; wood sample rods; enchanted measuring tape; brass scales; counter bell; quill and ink; ledger; dusty travel trunk; ladder stool; stained-glass lamp; iron wall sconce; worn cobble threshold; potted fern.
shops.status: concept reference for the implemented native shop
